Elaine (PM): Heads up 5: AcmeCorp wants full SSO + audit retention + SLA before pilot. Can we scope this into MVP and still hit 2026-04-15?
Raj (Eng): Quick thought 5: SAML SP login + simple mapping = doable fast. SCIM/group sync + retention UI + compliance docs = multi-week.
Sam (EngLead): Two realistic paths: a) Keep MVP date and ship a trimmed SSO surface; b) Push milestone 1 sprint and include broader ent features. Which buys the most enterprise confidence?
Morgan (Design): We can produce a minimal SSO flow for MVP (hosted connect + email mapping) and postpone admin UX. That reduces surface by ~3 screens.
Lee (Data): Emitting audit events is easy; retention/query tooling is medium. We can emit and archive to cold storage initially.
pm-bot: milestone/2026-04-15 created by Elaine.
Elaine (PM): Proposed split: MVP includes: SAML SP-initiated login, email->user mapping, audit event emission (no retention UI), basic creds rotation; v1 includes: SCIM/group sync, tenant admin console, retention policy UI, long-term archival and query. Agree?
Raj (Eng): Fine but define "email mapping" explicitly: email must be verified/claimed or we risk duplicates. No SCIM in MVP.
Sam (EngLead): I'll run a 3d spike to validate IdP integrations and list necessary test cases. 3d -> dev estimate after.
Morgan (Design): I'll hand off reduced flows + copy for admin-facing docs by Thu EOD.
Lee (Data): I'll draft event schema & archival flag. Will open PR Thurs.
Elaine (PM): Cutlist (MVP -> defer to v1):
```
- Tenant admin console (defer)
- Group sync / SCIM provisioning (defer)
- Retention policy editor (defer)
- Advanced admin dashboards (defer)
- In-app SSO provisioning UI (defer; docs/manual setup for MVP)
```
Sam (EngLead): +1. Also propose a fallback for pilot: if SSO fails, enable email-invite login behind feature flag. Low risk.
Raj (Eng): Agreed. Operational note: we need a runbook for IdP troubleshooting and a DDoS baseline check but that shouldn't block MVP.
Sam (EngLead): I'll include feature-flagged fallback in the spike and add test cases.
Elaine (PM): Decision checkpoint: spike results by Thu -> commit by Fri. If spike <=2w work for dev, we keep 2026-04-15. If >2w, we shift milestone by one sprint and ship trimmed MVP. I'll update Acme with that timeline.
pm-bot: Reminder: retrospective scheduled Friday 10:00.
Morgan (Design): Dropping admin mocks now 5. Delivering trimmed flows Thu morning.
Lee (Data): Schema PR target Thu.
Raj (Eng): Quick ask: ensure we log SSO success/failure metrics so Support can triage pilot issues.
Elaine (PM): Good call. Add to MVP acceptance criteria: IdP success rate logging + rollback path to email invites.
Sam (EngLead): I'll update the milestone notes and the acceptance criteria after spike.
Elaine (PM): Thank you team. Communicating plan to Acme: either pilot on 2026-04-15 with trimmed scope, or pilot delayed one sprint with full ent features. :thumbsup:
